title: BentoBox Blueprint Format
description:
Schema describing the on-disk JSON format used by BentoBox for island blueprints (.blueprint files) and blueprint bundles (bundle .json files).

FILE FORMATS:
  - `.blueprint` files are plain UTF-8 JSON and MUST validate against `#/$defs/Blueprint`.
  - `.blu` files are a legacy format: a ZIP archive containing a single entry whose content is plain JSON that validates against `#/$defs/Blueprint`.
  - Bundle files (e.g. `default.json` inside a game mode's `blueprints/` folder) MUST validate against `#/$defs/BlueprintBundle`.

SERIALIZATION NOTES (Gson-based):
  - Only fields explicitly tagged `@Expose` in the Java source are serialized; producers must not emit other keys.
  - `org.bukkit.util.Vector` values are emitted as a 3-element JSON array of numbers: `[x, y, z]`.
  - Maps keyed by `Vector` use Gson's complex-map-key form: a JSON array of 2-element arrays, i.e. `[[<vector>, <value>], ...]` — NOT a JSON object. This applies to `Blueprint.blocks`, `Blueprint.attached`, and `Blueprint.entities`.
  - Maps keyed by an enum (e.g. `BlueprintBundle.blueprints` keyed by `World.Environment`) ARE emitted as normal JSON objects with the enum NAME as the key.
  - Maps keyed by `Integer` (inventory slot -> ItemStack) are emitted as JSON objects with stringified integer keys.
  - `org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack` values are serialized to Bukkit YAML (via ConfigurationSerializable) and stored as a JSON string. They cannot be validated structurally by this schema; treat the value as an opaque YAML document.
  - Enum values are serialized by their Java `name()`.
  - `org.bukkit.Color` is serialized as `{"ALPHA": int, "RED": int, "GREEN": int, "BLUE": int}` via ConfigurationSerializable.
  - Pretty-printing is enabled by the writer; consumers must not rely on whitespace.

Vector.title: Vector
Vector.description: A Bukkit Vector serialized as a 3-element JSON array of doubles: [x, y, z]. For block positions, integer values are customary but the underlying type is double. For entity positions, sub-block fractional components are allowed.

ItemStackYaml.title: ItemStack (YAML-encoded)
ItemStackYaml.description: A Bukkit ItemStack serialized via Bukkit's ConfigurationSerializable as a YAML document and stored as a JSON string. The string SHOULD be parseable by `org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack#deserialize` or by `YamlConfiguration#loadFromString`. No structural validation is performed by this schema.

Color.title: Color
Color.description: An RGBA color, serialized via Bukkit's ConfigurationSerializable.

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: Icon material. One of: a plain Bukkit Material enum name (e.g. `DIAMOND`), a vanilla namespaced key (e.g. `minecraft:diamond`), or a resource pack custom model key (e.g. `myserver:island_tropical`). Default: `PAPER`.

VectorKeyedBlockMap.title: Vector-keyed block map
VectorKeyedBlockMap.description: Gson complex-map-key form: an array of [VectorKey, BlueprintBlock] pairs.

VectorKeyedEntityListMap.title: Vector-keyed entity-list map
VectorKeyedEntityListMap.description: Gson complex-map-key form: an array of [VectorKey, BlueprintEntity[]] pairs. Multiple entities can share the same tile (e.g. a villager and an item frame in one block space).

InventoryMap.title: Inventory slot map
InventoryMap.description: Map of zero-based inventory slot to ItemStack (YAML-encoded). Keys are stringified integers; absent slots are empty.

Blueprint.title: Blueprint
Blueprint.description: Top-level object written to a `.blueprint` file. Describes a block volume, attached blocks, and entities relative to an anchor (`bedrock`).

name.description: Unique identifier for this blueprint; used to look it up from a BlueprintBundle. Conventionally matches the filename stem. Non-null; default empty string.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in UIs. May contain legacy `§` colour codes or MiniMessage tags depending on locale conventions.

description.description: Lore lines shown under the icon in selection UIs.

bedrock.description: Anchor point of the blueprint. When pasted, blueprint (0,0,0) is translated so `bedrock` lands on the paste target. If omitted at load-time, BentoBox auto-creates one at `(xSize/2, ySize/2, zSize/2)`.

xSize.description: Width of the bounding box in blocks (X axis).

ySize.description: Height of the bounding box in blocks (Y axis).

zSize.description: Depth of the bounding box in blocks (Z axis).

sink.description: If true, at paste time the blueprint will descend until it finds a surface, rather than pasting at the exact Y of the anchor.

blocks.description: Primary blocks of the blueprint, keyed by position relative to the blueprint origin (0..size-1 on each axis).

attached.description: Blocks that must be pasted AFTER `blocks` because they attach to a supporting block (torches, ladders, rails, beds, doors, signs, etc.). Same coordinate conventions as `blocks`.

entities.description: Entities to spawn at each position. The position key is the block the entity resides in; fine-grained in-block offsets live on BlueprintEntity (x/y/z fields). Multiple entities may share a key.

BlueprintBundle.title: BlueprintBundle
BlueprintBundle.description: A bundle groups up to three blueprints — one per world environment — into a single selectable option in the island-create UI. Persisted as `<uniqueId>.json` inside a game mode's `blueprints/` folder (alongside the `.blueprint` files it references).

uniqueId.description: Unique identifier for this bundle. Must equal the filename stem (e.g. `default` for `default.json`). Used as a permission suffix when `requirePermission` is true.

description.description: Lore shown under the icon in the selection UI.

blueprints.description: Map from world environment to the `name` of a Blueprint present in the same folder. Environments with no entry are not generated for this bundle.

requirePermission.description: If true, using this bundle requires the permission `<gamemode>.island.create.<uniqueId>`.

slot.description: Preferred slot in the selection GUI (0-based). Slots are clamped at runtime.

times.description: Maximum number of islands a single player may create with this bundle. `0` means unlimited.

cost.description: Vault-economy cost a player pays to use this bundle. `0` means free. Requires a Vault-compatible economy plugin at runtime.

commands.description: Commands executed when an island is created with this bundle. Placeholders `[player]` and `[owner]` are substituted. Entries prefixed with `[SUDO]` run as the player; others run as console.

BlueprintBlock.title: BlueprintBlock
BlueprintBlock.description: One block cell of a blueprint. The `blockData` string is required; all other fields are applied only when the block type supports them.

blockData.description: Bukkit BlockData string, i.e. the output of `BlockData#getAsString()`. Examples: `minecraft:bedrock`, `minecraft:oak_log[axis=y]`, `minecraft:chest[facing=north,type=single,waterlogged=false]`.

signLines.description: Front-side sign lines (up to 4). Supports legacy `§` colour codes. DEPRECATED since BentoBox 1.24.0 in favour of side-specific serialisation; still written and read for backwards compatibility.

signLines2.description: Back-side sign lines (up to 4). Added in 1.24.0 when dual-sided signs were introduced.

glowingText.description: Whether the front side of this sign has glowing text.

glowingText2.description: Whether the back side of this sign has glowing text.

inventory.description: Container contents (chests, barrels, hoppers, shulker boxes, furnaces, brewing stands, etc.). Keyed by slot index.

bannerPatterns.description: Banner pattern layers, applied in order. Each entry is a Bukkit Pattern serialized via ConfigurationSerializable with keys `pattern` (legacy short code, e.g. `bri`) and `color` (DyeColor name).

biome.description: Biome override for this specific block cell (Bukkit `Biome` enum name). Optional.

creatureSpawner.description: Present only when `blockData` is a spawner. Describes the spawner configuration.

trialSpawner.description: Present only when `blockData` is a trial spawner (1.21+). Mutually exclusive with `creatureSpawner`.

itemsAdderBlock.description: ItemsAdder custom block namespace identifier (e.g. `myserver:custom_ore`). Only meaningful when the ItemsAdder plugin is installed; otherwise the block falls back to `blockData`.

delay.description: Current countdown (ticks) until the next spawn attempt.

maxNearbyEntities.description: Spawner will stop spawning while at least this many entities of the spawned type exist within its tracking radius.

maxSpawnDelay.description: Upper bound (ticks) of the randomised delay picked after a spawn.

minSpawnDelay.description: Lower bound (ticks) of the randomised delay picked after a spawn.

requiredPlayerRange.description: Maximum distance (blocks) from which a player keeps the spawner active.

spawnRange.description: Radius (blocks) around the spawner within which mobs may spawn.

BlueprintTrialSpawner.title: BlueprintTrialSpawner
BlueprintTrialSpawner.description: Trial spawner configuration (1.21+). Added in BentoBox 3.4.2.

ominous.description: Whether the spawner is in its ominous (cursed) state.

spawnedType.description: Single entity type to spawn. Use this OR `potentialSpawns`.

addSimulEnts.description: Additional simultaneous entities granted per player (scaling factor).

addSpawnsB4Cool.description: Additional total spawns granted per player before cooldown.

baseSimEnts.description: Base number of simultaneous entities the spawner will keep alive.

baseSpawnsB4Cool.description: Base number of total spawns before entering cooldown.

lootTableMap.description: Candidate reward loot tables with relative weights. Keyed by a loot-table NamespacedKey object.

potentialSpawns.description: Weighted list of possible spawns. Use this OR `spawnedType`.

snapshot.description: EntitySnapshot serialised as a string (Bukkit `EntitySnapshot#getAsString`). Opaque to this schema.

spawnrule.description: Bukkit SpawnRule serialised via ConfigurationSerializable. Keys depend on server version; typically includes block-light / sky-light / min/max Y fields.

BlueprintEntity.title: BlueprintEntity
BlueprintEntity.description: One entity to spawn. Only `type` is required; all other fields are applied only when the Bukkit entity class supports them. Nullable wrappers indicate a tri-state: unset means "do not modify Bukkit default".

customName.description: Custom display name; supports legacy `§` colour codes.

x.description: Fine offset within the position cell (typically 0.0 ≤ x < 1.0 for relative placement, but absolute values are allowed).

visualFire.description: Render a fire effect regardless of `fireTicks`.

adult.description: Ageable entities only — set false to spawn as baby.

color.description: Colourable entities only (sheep, shulker, collar colour for wolves, etc.).

tamed.description: Tameable entities only. Owner is not restored.

profession.description: Villager profession (enum name or namespaced key string).

villagerType.description: Villager biome/type variant (enum name or namespaced key string).

style.description: Horse coat style — Bukkit `Horse.Style` enum name.

npc.description: Citizens plugin NPC id. Only meaningful when Citizens is installed.

displayRec.description: Properties common to all DisplayEntity subtypes.

DisplayRec.title: DisplayRec
DisplayRec.description: Properties shared by all Display entities (BlockDisplay, ItemDisplay, TextDisplay).

billboard.description: How the display rotates to face the viewer.

brightness.description: Bukkit Display.Brightness — typically `{"block": int, "sky": int}` via ConfigurationSerializable. Opaque.

transformation.description: Bukkit Transformation (translation, leftRotation, scale, rightRotation) via ConfigurationSerializable. Opaque.

text.description: Displayed text. Legacy `§` colour codes accepted.

opacity.description: Signed byte: -1 renders the default opacity.

EntityType.description: Bukkit EntityType enum name (e.g. `VILLAGER`, `ZOMBIE`, `ARMOR_STAND`, `ITEM_FRAME`, `ITEM_DISPLAY`, `BLOCK_DISPLAY`, `TEXT_DISPLAY`, `TRIAL_SPAWNER`). The exact set depends on the server version.
